title: Social Media Privacy Hardening Checklist
metaDescription: Complete privacy checklist for Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and X. Secure your social media accounts with these essential privacy settings.
intro: Social media platforms collect vast amounts of personal data and share it with advertisers and third parties. This comprehensive checklist will help you lock down your privacy settings across major platforms and protect your digital footprint.

items.task: Set profile visibility to Friends only
items.why: Prevents strangers from viewing your personal information and photos
items.howTo: Go to Settings & Privacy > Settings > Privacy > Who can see your future posts, and select 'Friends'. Also check 'Who can look you up' settings.

items.why: Prevents Facebook from automatically tagging you in photos and building facial recognition data
items.howTo: Go to Settings & Privacy > Settings > Face Recognition and turn off 'Do you want Facebook to be able to recognize you in photos and videos?'

items.task: Limit ad targeting and data sharing
items.why: Reduces how much personal data is used for targeted advertising
items.howTo: Visit Settings & Privacy > Settings > Ads. Turn off ads based on data from partners, ads based on your activity on Facebook Company Products.

items.why: Apps can access your Facebook data even when you're not using them
items.howTo: Go to Settings & Privacy > Settings > Apps and Websites. Review and remove apps you no longer use or don't recognize.

items.why: Only approved followers can see your posts, stories, and profile information
items.howTo: Go to Settings > Privacy > Account Privacy and turn on 'Private Account'.

items.why: Prevents strangers from viewing your stories and limits unwanted interactions
items.howTo: Go to Settings > Privacy > Story. Set 'Allow sharing' to off and customize who can reply to your stories.

items.why: Hides when you were last active on Instagram from other users
items.howTo: Go to Settings > Privacy > Activity Status and turn off 'Show Activity Status'.

items.why: Understanding what data Instagram has collected helps you make informed privacy decisions
items.howTo: Go to Settings > Security > Download Data to see what information Instagram has about you.

items.why: Requires approval for followers and makes your videos visible only to approved users
items.howTo: Go to Settings and Privacy > Privacy > Private account and turn it on.

items.why: Reduces how TikTok uses your data for targeted content and ads
items.howTo: Go to Settings and Privacy > Privacy > Personalization and data. Turn off personalization features you're uncomfortable with.

items.why: Prevents TikTok from accessing and sharing your location data
items.howTo: In your phone settings, find TikTok and turn off location access. Also check Settings and Privacy > Privacy > Location Services in the app.

items.why: Makes your tweets private so only approved followers can see them
items.howTo: Go to Settings and Privacy > Privacy and Safety > Audience and Tagging > Protect your Tweets.

items.why: Prevents X from using your data for targeted advertising
items.howTo: Go to Settings and Privacy > Privacy and Safety > Ads Preferences and turn off 'Personalized ads'.

items.task: Limit data sharing with business partners
items.why: Prevents X from sharing your data with third-party advertisers
items.howTo: In Privacy and Safety > Ads Preferences, turn off 'Allow additional information sharing with business partners'.

items.task: Use Incognito Browser for social media browsing
items.why: Provides built-in privacy protection and blocks tracking across social media sites
items.howTo: Download Incognito Browser and use it when accessing social media platforms to prevent cross-site tracking and protect your browsing data.

items.task: Enable two-factor authentication on all accounts
items.why: Adds an extra layer of security to prevent unauthorized access
items.howTo: In each platform's security settings, find two-factor authentication and enable it using SMS or an authenticator app.

items.why: Social media platforms frequently change privacy policies and add new features
items.howTo: Set a monthly reminder to review privacy settings on all your social media accounts and adjust as needed.
